name: photonforge
description: PhotonForge PCell, layout, routing, circuit/time-domain simulation, project versioning + cloud-GUI (photonforge-server), serialization, GUI automation, LiveViewer, variation-aware yield/DFM, and documentation guidance for AI coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: AI guidance for PhotonForge PCells, routing, LVS, circuit simulation, project versioning + cloud GUI, yield/DFM, and docs lookup.
interface.longDescription: Use PhotonForge through your AI coding agent for parametric component authoring, technology-aware layout construction, schematic-to-layout routing, LVS-style verification, circuit and time-domain simulation, version-controlled cloud projects and the browser-GUI API (create/edit/simulate projects, set up photonforge-server), design serialization, cloud-GUI automation, LiveViewer visualization, and variation-aware yield/tolerance analysis (surrogate models over process corners + wafer/lot Monte Carlo). Includes tidy3d-mcp in PhotonForge product mode for current documentation and API lookup.
defaultPrompt: Help me write a PhotonForge parametric component.
Route this PhotonForge schematic intent into physical layout.
Review this PhotonForge layout for LVS and port-connectivity issues.
Run a time-domain simulation of this PhotonForge circuit.
Version-control this PhotonForge project and open it in the browser GUI.
How do fabrication variations affect this circuit's yield?
